label: Order
caption: CITY OF TULSA, OKLAHOMA V. JUSTIN HOOPER
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, case No. 22-5034, is hereby stayed until 5 p.m. (EDT) on Wednesday, August 2, 2023. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Monday, July 31, by 12 p.m. (EDT). Neil M. Gorsuch Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States
